performance.verdict: CPL win is real, but scale-up is blocked by 6 overdue SOW gates.

findings.text: 6 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: Booking bot 2026-07-31); intake owner gap directly blocks the scale-up gate per engagement plan.
CPL fell 49.93% week-over-week to an implied ~$124 (vs ~$249 28-day avg) while leads rose 50%; Meta drove all 7 tracked leads on $699 spend.
3-day signal (Sep 8–10) shows 0 leads and avg spend of $53/day vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7) which yielded 2 leads on avg $79/day — short-window efficiency is reversing.
"Quality HVAC by Fibid" GBP profile: 187 impressions over 24 days, 0 calls, 0 directions — call rate 0.00 vs 0.0197 on the Solutions profile; listing issue confirmed by flag.
GHL shows 522 opportunities created but only 40 won and 0 appointments logged; with intake owner vacant since 7/7, leads arriving may not be worked — an intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Audit 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' GBP call button and phone number — 0 calls on 187 impressions is a confirmed listing defect.
suggestions.monday_update: The 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' profile recorded 0 calls against 187 impressions over 24 days (call rate 0.00 vs 0.0197 on the Solutions profile).
